WITH date_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
customer_address_filtered AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
),
sales_channels AS (
    SELECT customer_sk,
           MAX(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 1 END) AS has_store,
           MAX(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN 1 END) AS has_web,
           MAX(CASE WHEN channel = 'catalog' THEN 1 END) AS has_catalog
    FROM (
        SELECT ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk, 'store' AS channel
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk, 'web' AS channel
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk, 'catalog' AS channel
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_dim_filtered dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    ) sales
    GROUP BY customer_sk
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, count(*) cnt1,
       cd.cd_purchase_estimate, count(*) cnt2,
       cd.cd_credit_rating, count(*) cnt3
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address_filtered ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
LEFT JOIN sales_channels sc ON sc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE sc.has_store = 1
  AND sc.has_web IS NULL
  AND sc.has_catalog IS NULL
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
